title: Ordinal Numbers: 1st to 10th
seo_title: Grade 1 Ordinal Numbers Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 1)
standard_text: Describe the position of objects using ordinal numbers: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, up to 10th.
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 ordinal numbers worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: 1st to 10th, ordinal words, positions from the left and right, and stories. 100 questions with pictures and answers.
key_sub: Check which end you count from.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Ordinal numbers tell the position: 1st (first), 2nd (second), 3rd (third), 4th (fourth) … 10th (tenth).
  • Check where to start counting: from the left, from the right or from the front.
  • The 3rd child is one child. 3 children are three children.

Examples

Example

5 children in a line. Who is 2nd from the right?

count from the right: 1st, 2nd

Answer: the 4th from the left

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Wrong endRead where to start.
3rd or 3?3rd is one position.
Counting the startStart with 1st at the end of the line.

faq.q: What does MATATAG Math 1 ask about ordinal numbers?
faq.a: Describe the position of objects using ordinal numbers: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, up to 10th.

faq.q: Where do children use ordinal numbers?
faq.a: In lines, races and the days of the month.

items.q: Who is first in the line?
items.e: Start at the front, next to the stall. Count: first. Angelo is first.

items.q: Who is second in the line?
items.e: Start at the front, next to the stall. Count: first, second. Rodel is second.

items.q: Who is third in the line?
items.e: Start at the front, next to the stall. Count: first, second, third. Ivan is third.

items.q: Who is fourth in the line?
items.e: Start at the front, next to the stall. Count: first, second, third, fourth. Bea is fourth.

items.q: Vincent is ___ in the line.
items.e: Count from the front: first, second. Vincent is second. Say “second”, not “two”.

items.q: Ivan is ___ in the line.
items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth. Ivan is fifth. Say “fifth”, not “five”.

items.q: Liza is ___ in the line.
items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third. Liza is third. Say “third”, not “three”.

items.q: Angelo is ___ in the line.
items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth. Angelo is sixth. Say “sixth”, not “six”.

items.q: Look for the front. Who is second?
items.e: The stall is on the right, so the front is on the right. Count from there: first, second. Dennis is second.

items.q: Look for the front. Who is first?
items.e: The stall is on the right, so the front is on the right. Count from there: first. Liza is first.

items.q: Look for the front. Who is fourth?
items.e: The stall is on the right, so the front is on the right. Count from there: first, second, third, fourth. Kenneth is fourth.

items.q: Look for the front. Who is third?
items.e: The stall is on the right, so the front is on the right. Count from there: first, second, third. Ivan is third.

items.q: Which position is the child with the arrow?
items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh. The child with the arrow is seventh.

items.q: Which position is the child with the arrow?
items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth. The child with the arrow is sixth.

items.q: Which position is the child with the arrow?
items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth. The child with the arrow is eighth.

items.q: Which position is the child with the arrow?
items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, tenth. The child with the arrow is tenth.

items.q: Which position is the child with the arrow?
items.e: The front is on the right. Count from the front: first, second, third. The child with the arrow is third.

items.q: Which position is the child with the arrow?
items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth. The child with the arrow is ninth.

items.q: Which position is the child with the arrow?
items.e: The front is on the right. Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth. The child with the arrow is fifth.

items.q: Which position is the child with the arrow?
items.e: The front is on the right. Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh. The child with the arrow is seventh.

items.q: Which symbol means this word?
items.e: 1st, 2nd and 3rd are special. The others end in “th”. “first” is written 1st.

items.q: Which symbol means this word?
items.e: 1st, 2nd and 3rd are special. The others end in “th”. “second” is written 2nd.

items.q: Which symbol means this word?
items.e: 1st, 2nd and 3rd are special. The others end in “th”. “third” is written 3rd.

items.q: Which symbol means this word?
items.e: 1st, 2nd and 3rd are special. The others end in “th”. “fourth” is written 4th.

items.q: Which symbol means this word?
items.e: 1st, 2nd and 3rd are special. The others end in “th”. “eighth” is written 8th.

items.q: Which word does the ribbon show?
items.e: 2nd is said “second”. It tells a position. It is second, not “two”.

items.q: Which word does the ribbon show?
items.e: 3rd is said “third”. It tells a position. It is third, not “three”.

items.q: Which word does the ribbon show?
items.e: 5th is said “fifth”. It tells a position. Spell it fifth: no “v” and no “e”.

items.q: Which word does the ribbon show?
items.e: 4th is said “fourth”. It tells a position. Spell it fourth, with a “u”.

items.q: Which word does the ribbon show?
items.e: 9th is said “ninth”. It tells a position. Spell it ninth: no “e” after the n.

items.q: Which ribbon is written correctly?
items.e: Ribbon C shows 2nd, which is right. Remember: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, then 4th, 5th, 6th.

items.q: Which ribbon is written correctly?
items.e: Ribbon A shows 3rd, which is right. Remember: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, then 4th, 5th, 6th.

items.q: Which ribbon is written correctly?
items.e: Ribbon D shows 1st, which is right. Remember: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, then 4th, 5th, 6th.

items.q: Which ribbon is not written correctly?
items.e: Ribbon C is wrong. 3th should be 3rd.

items.q: Which ribbon is not written correctly?
items.e: Ribbon B is wrong. 2st should be 2nd.

items.q: Which symbol tells the position of the child with the arrow?
items.e: Count from the front: first, second. The child is second, written 2nd.

items.q: Which symbol tells the position of the child with the arrow?
items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third. The child is third, written 3rd.

items.q: Which symbol tells the position of the child with the arrow?
items.e: The front is on the right. Count from the front: first. The child is first, written 1st.

items.q: Which symbol tells the position of the child with the arrow?
items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh. The child is seventh, written 7th.

items.q: Which symbol tells the position of the child with the arrow?
items.e: The front is on the right. Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth. The child is ninth, written 9th.

sets.title: From the left or the right

items.q: Who is 1st from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count: first. Angelo is 1st from the left.

items.q: Who is 3rd from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count: first, second, third. Rodel is 3rd from the left.

items.q: Who is 2nd from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count: first, second. Maria is 2nd from the right.

items.q: Who is 4th from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count: first, second, third, fourth. Isabel is 4th from the left.

items.q: Who is 1st from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count: first. Carla is 1st from the right.

items.q: Who is 3rd from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count: first, second, third. Ella is 3rd from the right.

items.q: Who is 5th from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count: first, second, third, fourth, fifth. Vincent is 5th from the left.

items.q: Who is 4th from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count: first, second, third, fourth. Joshua is 4th from the right.

items.q: Which fruit is 2nd from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count: 1st, 2nd. The fruit 2nd from the left is the durian.

items.q: Which fruit is 3rd from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count: 1st, 2nd, 3rd. The fruit 3rd from the right is the apple.

items.q: Which fruit is 4th from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th. The fruit 4th from the left is the mango.

items.q: Which fruit is 1st from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count: 1st. The fruit 1st from the right is the apple.

items.q: Which fruit is 5th from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th. The fruit 5th from the left is the durian.

items.q: Which fruit is 4th from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th. The fruit 4th from the right is the durian.

items.q: Liza is ___ from the right.
items.e: Start at the right end and count to Liza: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th. Liza is 5th from the right.

items.q: Joshua is ___ from the right.
items.e: Start at the right end and count to Joshua: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th. Joshua is 5th from the right.

items.q: Rodel is 2nd from the left. What position is she from the right?
items.e: There are 7 children. From the right, count 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th up to Rodel. Rodel is 6th from the right.

items.q: Liza is 2nd from the left. What position is she from the right?
items.e: There are 6 children. From the right, count 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th up to Liza. Liza is 5th from the right.

items.q: Angelo is 3rd from the left. What position is she from the right?
items.e: There are 7 children. From the right, count 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th up to Angelo. Angelo is 5th from the right.

items.q: Dennis is 3rd from the left. What position is she from the right?
items.e: There are 8 children. From the right, count 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th up to Dennis. Dennis is 6th from the right.

items.q: What comes just after 3rd?
items.e: Just after means the next one. After 3rd comes 4th.

items.q: What comes just after 6th?
items.e: Just after means the next one. After 6th comes 7th.

items.q: What comes just after 9th?
items.e: Just after means the next one. After 9th comes 10th.

items.q: What comes just before 2nd?
items.e: Just before means the one in front of it. Before 2nd comes 1st.

items.q: What comes just before 5th?
items.e: Just before means the one in front of it. Before 5th comes 4th.

items.q: What comes just before 10th?
items.e: Just before means the one in front of it. Before 10th comes 9th.

items.q: Which position is between 3rd and 5th?
items.e: 3rd, 4th, 5th. 4th is between 3rd and 5th.

items.q: Which position is between 7th and 9th?
items.e: 7th, 8th, 9th. 8th is between 7th and 9th.

items.q: Who is just behind Dennis?
items.e: Dennis is third. Just behind her is the one nearer the back, so Rodel is fourth.

items.q: Who is just in front of Dennis?
items.e: Dennis is fourth. Just in front of her is the one nearer the front, so Maria is third.

items.q: Who is just behind Mae?
items.e: Mae is second. Just behind her is the one nearer the back, so Angelo is third.

items.q: Who is just in front of Bea?
items.e: Bea is fifth. Just in front of her is the one nearer the front, so Vincent is fourth.

items.q: Who is between Vincent and Angelo?
items.e: Vincent is second and Angelo is fourth. The child in the middle is Mae, who is third.

items.q: Who is between Ella and Jomar?
items.e: Ella is third and Jomar is fifth. The child in the middle is Kenneth, who is fourth.

items.q: Who is between Vincent and Arnel?
items.e: Vincent is fourth and Arnel is sixth. The child in the middle is Bea, who is fifth.

items.q: Kenneth is third. Arnel is just behind her. What position is Arnel?
items.e: Kenneth is third. Just behind her is the next place: fourth.

items.q: Ella is fifth. Patricia is just behind her. What position is Patricia?
items.e: Ella is fifth. Just behind her is the next place: sixth.

items.q: How many children are between the two arrows?
items.e: The arrows are at 2nd and 6th. The children between them are 3rd, 4th, 5th: that is 3. Do not count the children with the arrows.

items.q: How many children are between the two arrows?
items.e: The arrows are at 3rd and 8th. The children between them are 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th: that is 4. Do not count the children with the arrows.

items.q: How many children are between the two arrows?
items.e: The arrows are at 1st and 7th. The children between them are 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th: that is 5. Do not count the children with the arrows.

items.q: Ivan is 4th in the line at the canteen. How many children are in front of him?
items.e: The children in front of Ivan are 1st, 2nd and 3rd. That is 3. Do not count Ivan.

items.q: Maria is 6th in the line to buy kaya toast. How many children are in front of her?
items.e: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th are in front of Maria. That is 5 children.

items.q: 6 children run a race. Jomar comes in 1st. Patricia comes in last. What position is Patricia?
items.e: There are 6 runners, so last is 6th.

items.q: Angelo comes in 2nd in the race. Dennis comes in just after him. What position is Dennis?
items.e: Just after 2nd comes 3rd.

items.q: This is the podium for the race. Who came in 2nd?
items.e: Read the number on each block. The 2nd block is on the left. Rodel is 2nd. The tallest block is 1st.

items.q: Who came in 1st? Look at the numbers on the blocks.
items.e: The 1st block is in the middle. It is the tallest. Vincent came in 1st.

items.q: Isabel comes in 5th. Liza is just in front of her. What position is Liza?
items.e: Just in front of 5th is 4th.

items.q: On Sports Day, Mae finishes 3rd. How many children finish before her?
items.e: 1st and 2nd finish before Mae. That is 2 children.

items.q: 8 children are in a line. Kristine is 3rd from the front. What position is she from the back?
items.e: Count from the back: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th. Kristine is 6th from the back.

items.q: 9 children wait for the bus. Vincent is 2nd from the back. What position is he from the front?
items.e: Count from the front: 1st, 2nd, ... 8th. Vincent is 8th from the front.

items.q: Joshua is 3rd in the line. 4 children are behind him. How many children are in the line?
items.e: 2 children are in front, then Joshua, then 4 behind. 2 + 1 + 4 = 7.

items.q: Ella is 6th in the line. Carla is just behind her. What position is Carla?
items.e: Just behind 6th is 7th.

items.q: Arnel is 4th in the line. The 2 children in front buy their food and go. What position is she now?
items.e: Arnel had 3 children in front. 2 go, so 1 is left in front. Arnel is now 2nd.

items.q: Patricia is 3rd in the line. Kristine is 7th. How many children are between them?
items.e: Between 3rd and 7th are 4th, 5th and 6th. That is 3 children.

items.q: In a race, Joshua is 2nd and Dennis is 7th. How many runners are between them?
items.e: Between 2nd and 7th are 3rd, 4th, 5th and 6th. That is 4 runners.

items.q: Bea is 5th from the front. She is also 5th from the back. How many children are in the line?
items.e: 4 are in front of her and 4 are behind her. 4 + 1 + 4 = 9.

items.q: On a class trip, 10 learners line at the MRT station. Dennis is 4th from the back. What position is he from the front?
items.e: Count from the front: 1st, 2nd, ... 7th. Dennis is 7th from the front.

items.q: Patricia sits on the 3rd chair from the left. Jomar sits on the 3rd chair from the right. How many chairs are between them?
items.e: Patricia is on chair 3 from the left. Jomar is on chair 5 from the left. Only chair 4 is between them: 1 chair.

items.q: 10 children line for the slide at the playground. Jomar is 9th. How many children are behind him?
items.e: Only the 10th child is behind Jomar. That is 1 child.

items.q: On Sports Day, Angelo is 7th in the race. He runs past 2 children. What position is he now?
items.e: Passing a runner moves you 1 place nearer the front. 7th, then 6th, then 5th.
